thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for shard-7 OOMs. Root cause looks like progressive slab fragmentation + a steady stream of ~64B ephemeral allocations pinned by prefix index. Putting owners + short/medium-term fixes here.

ryan: I'll own fast triage for traces and flamegraphs. Plan: run live heap-scan + periodic snapshots, capture `malloc_site` histos. Command I'll run: `./bin/heap-scan --shard=shard-7 --interval=30s --out=/tmp/scan.json`

evan: I'll prototype a micro-eviction pass that trims prefix_map entries >3MB and LRU-age >120s. Will push a staging build for load-testing.

tara: Ops changes today (low-risk): reduce kv.soft_residency to 0.62 for shard-7 and enable emergency-eviction throttle on node-level at 75% mem. I'll coordinate maintenance window at 02:00 UTC.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Proposed rollout: staging->canary(5%)->prod(gradual). Canary auto-revert rules: p95 latency +10% or errors >1.5%.

maya: Short-term checklist (EOD):
  - ryan: heap-scan + upload flamegraphs (link)
  - tara: apply soft_residency change + mem-throttle schedule
  - evan: staging build of trimming pass + unit tests

ryan: Heap-scan ran. Snapshot links: https://internal/fg/23330 and https://internal/fg/23331. Evidence: 80% of churn from `prefix_index::insert_locked`. Allocation rate ~95k/s. Posting short trace snippet: ```#0 prefix_index::insert_locked
#1 prefix_map::emplace
#2 kv::handle_write
#3 http::request_handler
```

evan: Trimming pass landed in branch `evan/trim-small-prefixes`. Behavior: background trim every 45s, target reclaimed=~120MB/s under load. I'll add a feature flag `kv.trim_prefixes` and metric `kv.trim.reclaimed_bytes`.

tara: Deployed soft_residency=0.62 at 02:05 UTC. Observed immediate residency drop from 0.78 -> 0.64 on shard-7. Monitoring for 30m.

ops-bot: [incident-bot] OOM alerts suppressed after eviction window (2026-03-22T03:12:15Z). Node memory peak before action: 58.3GB, after: 21.1GB.

maya: Medium-term deliverables (owners + target dates):
  - ryan: automated periodic heap-scan + alerting when ephemeral alloc rate >50k/s (due 2026-03-29)
  - evan: integrate trimming into mainline with config + tests (due 2026-04-02)
  - tara: document rollback and emergency commands in ops runbook (due 2026-03-25)

ryan: Telemetry additions: `kv.ephemeral.alloc_rate`, `kv.prefix_index.size_p95`, `kv.residency.windowed_avg`. Will open PR for metrics pipeline and dashboard.

evan: Quick question on trimming semantics: prefer background best-effort reclamation OR fail-fast writer-side eviction? I prefer background to avoid adding write errors.

tara: Background reclamation preferred. If we need stricter controls later we can add writer-side rejects behind a feature flag.

maya: OK agreed. Also adding a recurring 2-week window review: run a 21-day histogram of residency per shard to detect slow growth patterns. I'll take first run and post findings next Monday.

ryan: Marking my task in-progress. Will paste flamegraph links + PR when ready.

evan: I'll schedule a canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC with 5% traffic under production-like load generator.

tara: Noted. I'll keep ops slack monitors on for auto-revert triggers.

maya: Thanks team. Update this thread with status changes. We'll close the follow-up once all deliverables are merged and canary passes for 72h.
